webfetch.name: webfetch
webfetch.description: Fetch content from a URL and convert to text, markdown, or HTML format. Supports intelligent content extraction and format conversion.

params.url: The URL to fetch content from (must start with http:// or https://)
params.format: The format to return the content in

name: Web Fetch
description: Fetch and extract content from web pages. Supports HTML, text, and markdown formats with intelligent conversion.

changelog.notes: Initial release — fetch any web page and get it back as clean text, markdown, or HTML
